titulo: ‘You’ve got me for life’: first ceremonies in England cement care leavers’ relationships
cuerpo: Lifelong guardianship ceremonies were announced in July as way to publicly affirm chosen connections Allan was 14 years old and had been through eight foster families and a stint in a children’s home when he began living with foster carer Russ in Kettering – a move that would change the course of his life. Russ, 63, fought for Allan to get the school placements he needed and took him to kickboxing every week, eventually joining in himself. When Allan turned 18, he moved out into his own flat, but the pair have stayed close. Continue reading...
